func (r *recv) act(a string, n int) {
	verb, arg := dev.Split(a)
	if n > 0 {
		switch verb {
		case dev.Unblock, dev.GuestAuth:
		default:
			return
		}
	}
	switch verb {
	case dev.Reboot:
	case dev.Scan, "spectrum-scan":
		switch {
		case arg == "x":
		}
	case dev.LED + ":" + dev.On:
	default:
	}
	switch r.Cmd {
	case "kick-sta", "kick":
	}
}

func flags(fs *flag.FlagSet) {
	url := flag.String("url", defaultURL, "inform URL")
	flag.BoolVar(&apply, "apply", false, "apply")
	every := fs.Duration("health-every", time.Minute, "period")
	fs.StringVar(&t.Addr, "ssh-listen", ":2222", "listen")
	fs.IntVar(&n, "n", 2*base, "count")
	name := "computed"
	flag.String(name, "x", "not a literal name")
	s.String("a", "b") // another String
	flag.Var(&v, "custom", "a flag.Value has no default argument")
}
